footer.tagline: Domek — a household planner for the people who live there.

installPrompt.title: Install Domek
installPrompt.body: Keep Domek on your home screen for faster access and a more app-like feel.
installPrompt.iosBody: Add Domek to your home screen from Safari: tap Share, then choose Add to Home Screen.
installPrompt.androidFallbackBody: If the install prompt does not appear, open your browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.

landing.heroSubtitle: Coordinate chores, shopping, expenses, and important dates without group chat chaos.
landing.heroByline: The calm alternative to sticky notes, group chats, and scattered apps.
landing.heroPreviewSummary: This week’s jobs, lists, dates, and shared costs stay together instead of drifting across notes and messages.
landing.problemTitle: Running a household gets messy fast
landing.problemIntro: Domek gives the everyday details a clear place to land, so everyone can see what needs attention without asking around.
landing.problemStickyNotes: The shopping list is in three different apps
landing.problemChoreTurns: That repair gets forgotten for two weeks
landing.problemForgottenBills: Bills get paid, but never tracked
landing.solutionSummary: Put the dates, jobs, lists, notes, and everyday money in one calm board that the whole household can open.
landing.socialProof: Trusted by early households across Europe
landing.previewTitle: Everything your household needs in one place
landing.previewSummary: Choose a feature to switch the product view.
landing.screenCalendarSummary: Calendar items sit beside household work, not in another silo.
landing.screenTodosSummary: Small jobs are visible enough to finish.
landing.screenShoppingSummary: A single list for the next shop and the top-ups in between.
landing.screenNotesSummary: Useful details stay findable after the conversation moves on.
landing.screenExpensesSummary: Track household costs without turning it into accounting software.
landing.screenChoresSummary: Recurring work stays visible before it becomes a debate.
landing.previewTodosItemLadder: Bring ladder back to the cellar
landing.previewNotesSnippetWifi: Guest network, alarm code reminder, and where the spare key lives.
landing.previewNotesSnippetTrip: Rain jackets, cards for the train, dog food, and chargers.
landing.previewNotesSnippetVet: Next appointment on Tuesday and medicine after breakfast.
landing.previewExpensesSummaryNote: Groceries, one repair, and the shared bits already split.
landing.featureCalendarSummary: Birthdays, bins, school days, guests, and all the little dates that keep the house moving.
landing.featureTodosSummary: The small jobs that used to live on scraps of paper and kitchen counters.
landing.featureShoppingSummary: Shared lists for the weekly shop, top-ups, and the things you always forget.
landing.featureNotesSummary: Wi-Fi notes, trip lists, pet care, and anything worth being able to find again.
landing.featureExpensesSummary: Shared costs, repairs, supplies, and the odd surprise bill - all in one place.
landing.featureChoresSummary: Recurring jobs, without the weekly “who did what” debate.
landing.faqTrialAnswer: Yes. Every new household starts with a 30-day free trial. You will not be charged until the trial ends.
landing.faqMembersQuestion: Can everyone in the household use it?
landing.faqMembersAnswer: Yes. One household plan covers the shared home board, so you can invite the people who live with you without paying per person.
landing.faqPrivacyAnswer: Yes. Domek is private by default and keeps household content inside your shared space, visible only to the people you invite.
landing.faqUseQuestion: What can we track in Domek?
landing.faqUseAnswer: You can keep shared dates, chores, to-dos, shopping lists, notes, and household expenses in one place instead of spreading them across chats and apps.
landing.faqCancelAnswer: Yes. You can cancel during the trial or before the next renewal from your account settings. If you cancel during trial, you will not be charged.
landing.bottomCtaSummary: Start your 30-day free trial and give the everyday details one shared place to land.
